Name: Rokunai's Common Food Ingredients
Author: rokunai
Description:
Convenient items for a simple (maybe too simple and less immersive) modding experience without any machines or items from other mods!
If you want cooking recipes, please check [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17831]Common Food Ingredients Item Pack[/url] mod!

This mod adds the items listed below:

[list]
[*]Black Tea Leaves (Cooking -made from Tea Leaves)
[*]Butter (Cooking -made from Milk)
[*]Caramel Syrup (Cooking -made from Sugar)
[*]Matcha (Cooking -made from Tea Leaves)
[*]Sweet Condensed Milk (Cooking -made from Milk and Sugar)
[*]Whipped Cream (Cooking -made from Milk and Sugar)
[*]Boba (Purchase from Gus)
[*]Lemon Juice (Purchase from Gus)
[*]Plain Soda (Purchas from Gus)
[*]Chocolate Bar (Purchase from Pierre)
[*]Salt (Purchase from Pierre)
[*]Savory Spices (Purchas from Pierre)
[*]Sweet Spices (Purchas from Pierre)
[*]Vanilla Pod (Purchas from Pierre)
[/list][list]
[*]Ice Cube Machine (Purchase from Robin/Purchase the recipe from Robin)
[*]Ice Cube (Produced from Ice Cube Machine for each 10 hours when placed in an indoor location)
[/list]
The purpose of this mod is, as the name says, to add the common food ingredients in a minimal form.
This mod is [b]open-to-use[/b], feel free to use you can use for your recipe/machine/shop. ([b]Note: don't copy-paste the items into your mod.[/b] JA items could be referenced from outside the mod.)
All entities (items, machines, and crops) in this mod are compatible with the same name entities in other mods.Convenient items for a simple (maybe too simple and less immersive) modding experience without any machines or items from other mods!

[line]
[b][b]///// [/b]Please check the below if the mod doesn't work! /////[/b]
(There's a large possibility that I made mistakes, but sometimes the error is caused by the condition of the users)

[b]Is all folders placed in the Stardew Valley\Mods folder?[/b]
This mod has no replaceable options.
Don't remove the [JA] or [PFM] folders or the folders that were placed in them. 

[b]Is the latest version of the required (not optional) mods installed?[/b]
This mod is a content pack.
The function of the mod is completely dependent on the frameworks, which you can see in the requirements section.
Not installing the required mods or forgetting to update them may cause errors.

[b]Is the [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log [/url]parser pointing out the error caused by this mod? 
[/b]The SMAPI log parser gives you information about the error that happened in your modded game.
It tells you what mod and why it is causing the error, and you may find the problem in your condition sometimes.
If you find the error is caused by the mod (it means it's my mistake), please send me the link to your error log.
It's helpful for mod authors to fix their problems.
